recentItems.title: US Russia Sanctions Bill | Russia Sanctions Reach Trump's Desk. Will India Get 100% Tariff Rate?
recentItems.description:
India faces a new tariff threat from the Donald Trump administration in the United States after the House of Representatives passed a broad package of sanctions targeting Russian officials and key pillars of its economy. The Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026 aims to empower President Trump to impose duties of up to 100 per cent on nations purchasing Russian energy, including India and China. 

The legislation, passed by the US Senate last month, received the final green light in the House in a 262-159 vote and now heads to President Donald Trump to be signed into law. The legislation represents the US' most ambitious effort to support Ukraine since Trump's return to the White House.

recentItems.description:

Backed by granted patents and built on real-world Indian operating data, ElecticaOS enhances operational reliability and extends battery lifespan to power India's energy transition.

recentItems.title: Reinventing Cardiovascular Care Through Smarter, Sustainable Reuse
recentItems.description:
Incredible Devices transform cardiovascular care with the Catheter Balloon Reprocessing System (CBRS) - the world’s first fully automated platform for reprocessing diagnostic and balloon catheters. Powered by patented Dynamic Fluid Cleaning technology, CBRS standardises cleaning, drying and documentation while helping reduce human error, infection risks and medical device waste. By enabling safe, efficient, and cost-effective reuse of critical consumables, the system supports hospitals in lowering procedural costs and expanding access to affordable cardiac interventions.
